options.command: BASE_REF=""; if git rev-parse --verify --quiet main >/dev/null; then BASE_REF="main"; elif git rev-parse --verify --quiet origin/main >/dev/null; then BASE_REF="origin/main"; fi; if [ -n "$BASE_REF" ] && git ls-tree -r --name-only "$BASE_REF" -- proto 2>/dev/null | grep -q '\.proto$'; then pnpm exec buf breaking --against "../../../.git#ref=${BASE_REF},subdir=libs/data-access/proto-contracts"; else echo "Skipping buf breaking: no baseline proto files found on main/origin/main."; fi

pnpm exec buf generate && mkdir -p ../py-interfaces/src/py_data_access_interfaces/gen && uv run --package py-data-access-interfaces python -m grpc_tools.protoc -I proto --python_out=../py-interfaces/src/py_data_access_interfaces/gen --pyi_out=../py-interfaces/src/py_data_access_interfaces/gen $(find proto -name '*.proto' | sort) && find ../py-interfaces/src/py_data_access_interfaces/gen -type d -exec touch {}/__init__.py \;
